summary: Gilead Sciences filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Arcellx, Inc. via a tender offer and merger. The consideration was $115.00 per share in cash plus one CVR (earn-out of $5.00 per CVR payable in 2030 if Arcellx's anito-cel product cumulative worldwide sales exceed $6.0B by December 31, 2029). The tender offer expired on April 27, 2026, with the merger effective April 28, 2026. No board recommendation or advisors are noted. The CVR includes a risk-arb angle as payout depends on commercial milestones; watch for future sales disclosures.
